g.text: Synthetic fleet of 60 cabin fans over 1 100 days: Weibull failure times, wear that grows in the last weeks, fan-speed changes and cabin temperature as confounders.
Model trained on 40 fans and tested on 20 others; an alarm needs three days in a row above threshold. Seed 5155.
